2. SCOPE OF WORK EXECUTED
Small Buildings works for National Expressway Development Authority completed 2013.
The work was carried out under site conditions that included existing services running across the corridor that had to be protected in
place. The agency organised its resources around this without recourse to the department for additional assistance, and the programme
was re-sequenced locally to keep the critical path intact.
An extension of time was granted during execution on account of restricted working hours imposed near the adjoining school. The delay
was examined by this office and held to be beyond the agency's control; no compensation was claimed and none has been paid.
The above work was executed under the supervision of the undersigned in accordance with the approved drawings, specifications, and
the terms and conditions of the contract. The work has been completed in all respects and has been got inspected by the Engineer-in-
Chief / Superintending Engineer.
3. QUALITY ASSESSMENT
The overall quality of the completed work is graded Good. Workmanship was satisfactory after remedial work on the first pour, and final
inspection was completed in the presence of the client's representative. Materials were drawn from approved sources and the test
results filed with this office were within the limits prescribed in the contract specification.

5. DEFICIENCY / OBSERVATION LIST
At the time of taking over, kerb alignment corrected over a 40 m stretch after joint inspection. Regarding site safety, one first-aid case
was recorded and closed with a toolbox briefing. The agency's conduct during the contract is recorded as responsive throughout the
defect liability period.
Nil. No major deficiencies observed during the final inspection carried out on 2013-03-09. All minor observations pointed out during the
interim inspections have been rectified to the satisfaction of the inspecting authority.
6. RECOMMENDATION
Having satisfied myself as to the quantity and quality of the work executed, and on the basis of the joint measurements recorded in the
measurement book, I certify the work complete and recommend release of the balance payment together with the retention money due
on expiry of the defect liability period. Certified by K. Pillai, Project Director.
The work has been completed in all respects as per the approved drawings, specifications, and contract conditions. The quality of work
has been found satisfactory during the final inspection carried out by the undersigned.
This certificate is issued for the sole purpose of recording completion of the above work and does not absolve the contractor of any obligations under the contract,
including the defect liability period.
